def design(feats) -> Design:
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = tuple(feats.ids); empty = Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    if n < 12 or p == 0 or len(np.unique(y)) < 2 or MAX_DRIVERS < 1: return empty
    labs = list(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum))
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.asarray(feats.stratum) == l for l in labs[1:]])
    def ll(Z=None):
        A = np.column_stack([base, Z]) if Z is not None else base
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
            H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - m)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-8: break
        eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30)
        return float(np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta)))
    def cols(sel, extra=()):
        z = [X[:, j] for j in sel] + [X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in extra]
        return np.column_stack(z) if z else None
    R = np.nan_to_num(np.corrcoef(X.T)).reshape(p, p)
    sel = []; cur = ll(); marginal = [ll(X[:, j]) for j in range(p)]
    for _ in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        candidates = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
        if not candidates: break
        v, j = max((ll(cols(sel + [j])), j) for j in candidates)
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * max(0, v - cur), 1) > 0.1 / p: break
        cluster = [c for c in candidates if abs(R[j, c]) >= 0.6]
        fits = {c: ll(cols(sel + [c])) for c in cluster}
        near = [c for c in cluster if fits[c] >= v - 2]
        j = max(near, key=lambda c: sum(R[c, d] ** 2 for d in cluster))
        sel.append(j); cur = fits[j]
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [s for s in sel if s != j]; v = ll(cols(rest))
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * max(0, cur - v), 1) > 0.05 / p:
                sel = rest; cur = v; changed = True; break
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs]); Pc = P - P.mean(0)
    sc = (Pc.T @ (y - y.mean())) ** 2 / (np.sum(Pc ** 2, 0) * y.var() + 1e-12)
    cand = []
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[i]; mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * max(0, ll(cols(mains, [(a, b)])) - ll(cols(mains))), 1)
        if pv < 0.001 / len(pairs): cand.append((pv, a, b))
    prods = []; drivers = list(sel)
    for pv, a, b in sorted(cand):
        new = [c for c in dict.fromkeys((a, b)) if c not in drivers]
        if len(prods) < 2 and len(drivers) + len(new) <= MAX_DRIVERS and not any({a, b} & {c, d} for c, d in prods):
            prods.append((a, b)); drivers.extend(new)
    msel = list(drivers)
    for c in list(msel):
        if c in sel: continue
        rest = [s for s in msel if s != c]
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * max(0, ll(cols(msel, prods)) - ll(cols(rest, prods))), 1) > 0.01 / p: msel = rest
    loadings = {}; best = None; seen = set()
    for j in range(p):
        group = tuple(c for c in range(p) if abs(R[j, c]) >= 0.6)
        if group in seen or len(group) < 3: continue
        seen.add(group); members = []
        for c in sorted(group, key=lambda c: -marginal[c]):
            if all(abs(R[c, d]) < 0.98 for d in members): members.append(c)
        if not 3 <= len(members) <= MAX_DRIVERS or prods: continue
        outside = [s for s in sel if all(abs(R[s, c]) < 0.6 for c in members)]
        if len(outside) + len(members) > MAX_DRIVERS: continue
        _, V = np.linalg.eigh(R[np.ix_(members, members)]); weights = V[:, -1]
        score = X[:, members] @ weights; Z = cols(outside)
        v = ll(score if Z is None else np.column_stack([Z, score])); gain = v - ll(Z)
        single = max(ll(cols(outside + [c])) for c in group)
        if v > single + 3 and stats.chi2.sf(2 * max(0, gain), 1) < 0.05 / p:
            if best is None or gain > best[0]: best = (gain, members, weights, outside)
    if best is not None:
        _, members, weights, outside = best; drivers = members + outside; msel = outside
        loadings = {ids[c]: float(w) for c, w in zip(members, weights)}
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in msel),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings=loadings)
